title: The Disconnect Between Better Descriptive Reasoning Trace Quality and Recommendation Effectiveness
abstract: arXiv:2608.23154v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work has focused on improving explicit natural-language descriptive reasoning traces for generative recommendation. This includes systems that augment semantic ID (SID) prediction with chain-of-thought reasoning. However, because SIDs are opaque learned identifiers rather than natural language, they require costly alignment before an LLM can reason over them. This provides a controlled experimental setting in which both item representation (Title vs. SID) and semantic grounding (minimal vs. extensive SID alignment) can be varied independently. We therefore present the first controlled comparison of descriptive reasoning trace quality across semantic IDs and natural-language titles in a 2 x 2 factorial study on three Amazon product domains using a shared Qwen3-1.7B backbone. translated_title: 更好的描述性推理轨迹质量与推荐有效性之间的脱节
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23154v1 公告类型：新 摘要：近期研究聚焦于改进生成式推荐中的显式自然语言描述性推理轨迹，包括将语义ID（SID）预测与链式思维推理相结合的系统。然而，由于SID是不透明的学习标识符而非自然语言，它们需要昂贵的对齐过程才能使大语言模型（LLM）进行推理。这提供了一个受控实验环境，其中物品表示（标题 vs. SID）和语义基础（最小 vs. 广泛的SID对齐）可以独立变化。因此，我们在三个亚马逊产品领域上，使用共享的Qwen3-1.7B骨干模型，进行了首个2×2因子设计研究，对语义ID和自然语言标题之间的描述性推理轨迹质量进行了受控比较。我们发现，在标准监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）训练下，引入显式描述性推理轨迹会降低传统的离线推荐有效性。
tldr: 该论文首次通过受控实验发现，在生成式推荐中引入显式描述性推理轨迹虽能提升推理质量，但会降低传统离线推荐效果，揭示了推理质量与推荐有效性之间的脱节。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first controlled experiment showing that introducing explicit descriptive reasoning traces in generative recommendation, while improving reasoning quality, reduces traditional offline recommendation effectiveness, revealing a disconnect between reasoning quality and recommendation performance.
